nodes.title: Reference video
widgets_values:
Limiting the reference video's longest edge reduces vision-encoding time, generation time, and VRAM use. Set the limit to 0 to keep the source resolution.

Keep the selected reference segment within MiniMax's official conditioning range of 2 to 15 seconds. QKV chunking reduces temporary VRAM peaks, but it does not replace a sensible reference resolution.

nodes.title: Launcher settings
widgets_values:
Recommended environment (option names vary by launcher and ComfyUI version):

• Enable the cudaMallocAsync CUDA allocator.  
• Enable asynchronous weight offloading; about two transfer streams is a practical starting point.  
• Keep pinned memory enabled and let ComfyUI size it from available system memory.  
• Enable Smart Memory Management or DynamicVRAM.  
• Prefer disabling system-memory fallback in the launcher or NVIDIA CUDA settings, so VRAM exhaustion does not silently become extremely slow execution.  
• Keep the VAE on the GPU when possible; use CPU VAE only when VRAM is genuinely insufficient.

These are recommendations, not hard node dependencies. Match the equivalent settings in your own ComfyUI build, launcher, GPU, memory capacity, and driver instead of copying option names from another bundle.

nodes.title: Reference image
widgets_values:
The maximum-long-edge limit reduces reference-image resolution, vision-encoding time, and VRAM pressure.

For first/last-frame conditioning, enable aspect-ratio adjustment and select the generated video's ratio to avoid distortion. Ordinary image references do not require forced cropping.

nodes.title: Model loading and precision protection
widgets_values:

Model mirror: https://pan.quark.cn/s/27f28ba550dc

nodes.title: LoRA compatibility
widgets_values:
The original LarryVRH minimax_h3_turbo_v4_step600 requires the author's dedicated LoRA loader. The minimax_h3_turbo_v4_step600_comfyui_T8-convert variant works with ComfyUI's standard LoRA loader.

A full-model LoRA may include layers that do not exist in a pruned checkpoint; the current chunk node applies compatible layers without flooding the log.

Use the Sigma Shift values published with the LoRA. Common starting points are 6 / 3 for 4-step LoRAs and 12 / 3 for 8-step LoRAs. Bypass Sigma Shift to restore the default 12 / 3 behavior.

nodes.title: Sigma Shift and chunk acceleration
widgets_values:
The attention path must match the GPU architecture: use an SM75 path on RTX 20-series GPUs and an SM80+ path on newer GPUs. CK is the general baseline. Select existing when another upstream node already owns attention acceleration.

CK offers the strongest quality baseline, Sol is a balanced option, and SLA prioritizes speed. Hybrid combines CK and a sparse path on complete sampling steps.

8192 is a practical starting point for the chunk controls. Attention output memory protection defaults to Off; enable it only for unusually long sequences that otherwise run out of VRAM, because it may reduce speed.

nodes.title: Workflow export
widgets_values:
The export node can embed the workflow directly in the video. Dropping that video onto Prompt Load later restores the prompt used for generation.

Messaging and social platforms may recompress videos and remove embedded metadata, so send the original file when the workflow must be preserved. Video only does not write workflow metadata.

Video + workflow PNG also creates a compact workflow PNG using the first video frame as its cover, which is useful as a visual workflow template card.

nodes.title: Live Preview
widgets_values:
Live Preview uses taeh3.safetensors from ComfyUI\models\vae_approx. The node includes automatic download, but manual installation is the reliable fallback when network access fails.

Preview overhead is small but not zero. Reduce its sample count or resolution, disable its display switch, or bypass the node when preview is unnecessary.

nodes.title: Prompt guidance
widgets_values:
Prompt quality directly affects shot structure, motion, subject consistency, and sound design. An AI assistant can follow MiniMax's official Skill to draft the prompt; provide the reference image or video as well so it can describe the source accurately.

Official Skill:
https://github.com/MiniMax-AI/MiniMax-H3/tree/main/skills

nodes.title: Second-pass refinement
widgets_values:
MiniMax H3 One-click HD requires minimax_h3_latent_upscaler_3d_fp16.safetensors in models\latent_upscale_models.

Choose enough tiles to keep each tile at roughly 1.0 MP or below for your hardware. For example, use four or even six tiles for a 4.0 MP target. The node refines tiles separately and stitches them into the final high-resolution video.

Automatic download is built in but may fail; manual installation is more reliable.

If you only need face restoration, double-click the canvas and replace this node with the Face Repair node. It requires models\ultralytics\bbox\face_yolov8m.pt.

widgets_values:
integrated_multimodal_description:

[Shot 1]
Live-action, cinematic, modern police-procedural thriller. A realistic forensic evidence room inside a criminal investigation unit. The lighting is cool, clean, and professional, with practical overhead light, computer monitor glow, and a restrained high-end procedural atmosphere.

A young detective stands beside a forensic workstation, holding a clean latent fingerprint film carefully between two fingers. A comparison monitor beside him shows a forensic match result clearly indicating a complete match to the deceased, forming an apparently perfect suicide-evidence chain.

The camera begins in a level medium close shot, clean and controlled, with no visual excess. The mood feels routine, efficient, and believable, like a normal case conclusion inside a professional police team.

The young detective looks toward the team leader with confidence and says in a firm, matter-of-fact voice (S1):
<d>[Chinese] 队长，现场只有死者指纹，自杀定论没问题。</d>

No subtitles or captions appear on screen.

The monitor interface remains visible in the background, suggesting a conclusive forensic match, while keyboard taps and equipment hum continue underneath the line.

[Shot 2] At 00:04.000, the camera cuts to a macro close-up.

A middle-aged team leader leans in. His expression turns sharp and intensely focused. The lens pushes into the fingerprint film and isolates one extremely subtle flaw near the outer edge: a tiny artificial trimming mark, almost invisible at first glance.

The environment sound narrows dramatically. The room tone falls away. No one speaks.

The camera pushes in further with microscopic attention to detail, locking onto the faint cut-like edge on the fingerprint film. The tension suddenly shifts from routine certainty to silent suspicion.

The team leader's breathing becomes just barely audible. His gaze hardens as he realizes the evidence has been manipulated.

[Shot 3] At 00:07.000, the camera cuts to a tight side-profile shot of the team leader.

The lighting becomes slightly darker and more contrast-driven, while the background softly falls away. His face remains calm, but his eyes carry cold certainty and controlled anger. The implication lands instantly: someone falsified evidence and tried to force the case into a closed suicide ruling.

He speaks quietly, firmly, and with piercing authority (S2):
<d>[Chinese] 指纹是后贴的。这不是自杀，是有人故意破坏现场。</d>

No subtitles or captions appear on screen.

Hold for a beat on his side profile as the meaning settles. The shot ends with a powerful suspenseful freeze in the atmosphere, as if a much larger hidden case has just begun to surface.

overall_soundscape:

Subtle keyboard tapping, low forensic equipment hum, quiet office room tone, and restrained investigative ambience in the opening. During the macro discovery shot, the environmental sound compresses until almost everything drops away except a faint breath and minimal room presence. In the final shot, a low tense silence dominates, allowing the final line to land with maximum weight.

non_diegetic_music:

A restrained modern investigative thriller score begins with subtle low-frequency pulses and minimal sustained textures. The music remains understated during the opening procedural setup. At the discovery of the trimming mark, the score tightens into sparse suspense. In the final shot, a deep low cinematic accent lands beneath the team leader's conclusion, followed by a lingering unresolved suspense tone that leaves a strong hook for a larger conspiracy.
